_meanings:
‘Not in the same row or line’; especially
 one who is not allowed by his caste-men to sit in the same row with them
 at meals; degraded, excommunicated, excluded from or inadmissible into
 society, an outcast; {#˚upahata#} defiled by the presence of excommunicated
